column_names_verification.trivet_script_compatibility_note: TRIVET script (tier1_validation_implementation_v2_STAGE_A_V2.py) reads the error-type column via row.get('Sub-Subtype', row.get('error_type', '')). It does NOT recognize 'expected_error_type'. Before running TRIVET, rename 'expected_error_type' to 'error_type' (or 'Sub-Subtype'). Other columns — 'clean_ar', 'error_ar', 'keyword' — are recognized as-is.
